rationale: Pivoting away from the flat output-head and small hyperparameter retries, this keeps the current recurrent-tail QK quantization path intact, moves to a slightly deeper and narrower 10x480 model for similar 600-second compute, and spends the recovered compression budget on one more float-kept tail projection block.
title: 10x480 Recurrent Tail With Extra FP16 Tail Projections
